prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Your new desktop companion is officially ready to join your workspace.", "Verified Companion"]
1: ["Each companion brings distinct idle animations and sound effects to your desktop.", "Tip: You can customize your companion's accessories anytime after setup."]
2: ["Creating Your Unique Desktop Pet...", "We are assembling high-resolution animations and desktop interactions for your companion."]
3: ["Begin Your Companion Journey", "Choose how you want to meet your new desktop companion today."]
4: ["Next: Check Desktop", "Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!", "Look at your screen overlay to see your new pet in action.", "Use your system tray menu anytime to summon or manage pet behavior.", "Finish Setup"]
5: ["Secure Your Pet Companion Account", "Signing in ensures your pet data, traits, and progress stay safely backed up.", "Your pet progress remains safe even if you re-install or switch devices."]
6: ["What Kind of Companion Fits Your Vibe?", "Tell us your preference so we can highlight your ideal pet match.", "See Matches"]
7: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion!", "Click and drag your pet anywhere on your desktop. Right-click to access commands, hide, or chat.", "Need to hide your pet during a presentation? Right-click the system tray icon anytime."]
8: ["Feel free to use other apps while we build your pet; we'll notify you when ready!"]
9: ["Save Your Custom Companion", "Sign in now to link your creation to your account before final adoption."]
